parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ReportStatus
parameters.description:
The compliance review status. Valid values: 
- **1**: Enabled.
- **0**: Disabled.

parameters.name: ResourceGroups
parameters.description:
The name of the protected object group to which the protected object is added.

> You must specify at least one of **Resources** and **ResourceGroups**.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: Resources
parameters.description:
The name of the protected object.

> You must specify at least one of **Resources** and **ResourceGroups**.

parameters.name: TraceStatus
parameters.description:
The tracing audit status. Valid values: 
- **1**: Enabled.
- **0**: Disabled.
